chapterInfo.content:
16
1 # Yoh 14.29 Yeinom na maka makyerɛ mo na moansunti. 2#Mat 24.9 Wɔbɛtu mo afiri hyia adan mu; mpo ɛberɛ reba a obiara a ɔbɛkum mo bɛsusu sɛ ɔde resom Onyankopɔn. 3#Yoh 15.21 Na wɔbɛyɛ yeinom, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnya nhunuu Agya no ne me. 4Na maka yeinom makyerɛ mo, na sɛ ɛberɛ no duru a, moakae sɛ maka makyerɛ mo.
Honhom Kronkron no adwuma
Na manka mo yeinom mamfiri mfitiaseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ me ne mo na na ɛwɔ hɔ. 5#Yoh 7.33 Na afei deɛ, merekɔ deɛ ɔsomaa me no nkyɛn, na mo mu biara mmisa me sɛ: Ɛhe na worekorɔ? 6Na sɛ maka yeinom makyerɛ mo nti, awerɛhoɔ ahyɛ mo akoma ma.
7 # Yoh 14.16; 14.26 Na meka mo nokorɛ; ɛyɛ ma mo sɛ mekorɔ. Na sɛ mankɔ a, Okyigyinafoɔ no remma mo nkyɛn, na sɛ mekɔ a, mɛsoma no aba mo nkyɛn. 8#1 Ko 14.24 Na ɔno deɛ, sɛ ɔba a, ɔbɛyi wiase atɛn bɔne ne tenenee ne atemmuo ho. 9#Yoh 3.18 Bɔne ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnye me nni; 10#Aso 5.31; Rom 4.25 ne tenenee ho, ɛfiri sɛ merekɔ Agya no nkyɛn, na monhu me bio; 11#Yoh 12.31; 14.30 ne atemmuo ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔabu wiase sodifoɔ no atɛn.
12 # 1 Ko 3.1 Mewɔ nsɛm pii meka mekyerɛ mo, nanso montumi nsoa seesei. 13#Yoh 14.26; 1 Yoh 2.27 Na sɛ ɔno, nokorɛ Honhom no, nya ba a, ɔbɛkyerɛ mo kwan akɔ nokorɛ no nyinaa mu. Na ɛmfiri ɔno ara ne mu na ɔbɛkasa, na biribiara a ɔbɛteɛ no, ɔbɛka, na ɔbɛkyerɛ mo nnoɔma a ɛreba. 14Ɔno na ɔbɛhyɛ me animuonyam; ɛfiri sɛ, ɔbɛfa me deɛ bi na ɔde abɛkyerɛ mo. 15#Yoh 17.10 Nnoɔma a m’Agya wɔ nyinaa yɛ me dea; yei nti na mekaa sɛ: Ɔbɛfa me deɛ bi na ɔde abɛkyerɛ mo.
Awerɛhoɔ bɛdane anigyeɛ
16 # Yoh 14.19 Aka kakraa bi na monhu me; na bio aka kakraa bi mobɛhu me. 17Ɛnna n’asuafoɔ no mu binom kekaa no wɔn mu sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ɔse yɛn yi sɛ: Aka kakraa bi na monhu me, na bio aka kakraa bi mobɛhu me, ne sɛ: Merekɔ Agya no nkyɛn yi? 18Ɛnna asuafoɔ no se: Ɛdeɛn ne deɛ ɔka yi sɛ: Aka kakraa bi? Yɛnte deɛ ɔreka yi ase. 19Ɛnna Yesu hunuu sɛ wɔrepɛ abisa no, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Yei ho na mobisabisa wɔ mo mu sɛ mekaa sɛ: Aka kakraa bi na monhu me, na bio aka kakraa bi mobɛhu me. 20Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Mobɛsu na moatwa adwo, na wiasefoɔ ani bɛgye; na mo deɛ, mo werɛ bɛho, nanso mo awerɛhoɔ no bɛdane anigyeɛ. 21#Yes 26.17 Ɔbaa, sɛ ɔrewo a, ɔte yea, ɛfiri sɛ ne dɔn adu; na sɛ ɔnya wo ɔba no a, ɔnkae ahohia no bio, anigyeɛ a wanya sɛ wɔawo ɔba aba wiase no nti. 22Na mo nso, seesei deɛ, mowɔ awerɛhoɔ; na mɛhu mo bio, na mo akoma bɛtɔ mo yam, na mo anigyeɛ no, obi rennye mo nsam; 23#Yoh 14.20; 14.13-14 na da no moremmisa me biribiara. Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Biribiara a mobɛsrɛ Agya no me din mu no, ɔde bɛma mo. 24#Yoh 15.11 Ɛde bɛduru sɛsɛɛ deɛ, monsrɛɛ biribi me din mu; monsrɛ, na mobɛnya, na mo anigyeɛ awie pɛyɛ.
Wiase so nkonimdie
25 Yeinom na maka mo mmebuo mu; na berɛ no reba a merenkasa menkyerɛ mo mmebuo mu bio, na mɛka Agya no ho asɛm makyerɛ mo pefee. 26Da no na mobɛsrɛ wɔ me din mu, na menka menkyerɛ mo sɛ mɛbisa Agya no mama mo, 27#Yoh 14.21 na Agya no ara dɔ mo, ɛfiri sɛ modɔ me, na moagye adi sɛ mefiri Agya no nkyɛn na mebaeɛ. 28Mefiri Agya no nkyɛn na mebaa wiase; na bio, merefiri wiase na makɔ Agya no nkyɛn.
29 # Yoh 16.25 N’asuafoɔ no see no sɛ: Hwɛ, afei deɛ, wokasa pefee, na wommu bɛ biara. 30Afei yɛahunu sɛ wonim nnoɔma nyinaa, na ɛnhia wo sɛ obi bisa woɔ; yei mu na yɛgye di sɛ wofiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn na ɛbaeɛ. 31Yesu bisaa wɔn sɛ: Afei deɛ, mogye di anaa? 32#Sak 13.7; Mat 26.31; Mar 14.27; Yoh 8.29 Hwɛ, dɔn no reba, na anya adu sɛ mo nyinaa bɛhwete akɔ mo nkuro mu, na moagya me nko; nanso ɛnkaa me nko, ɛfiri sɛ Agya no ka me ho. 33#Yoh 14.27; Rom 5.1; 1 Yoh 5.4 Yeinom na maka mo, na moanya me mu asomdwoeɛ. Mo ho bɛhiahia mo wiase deɛ, nanso momma mo bo ntɔ mo yam! Madi wiase so nkonim.

pageProps.chapterText:
Yeinom na maka makyerɛ mo na moansunti. Wɔbɛtu mo afiri hyia adan mu; mpo ɛberɛ reba a obiara a ɔbɛkum mo bɛsusu sɛ ɔde resom Onyankopɔn. Na wɔbɛyɛ yeinom, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnya nhunuu Agya no ne me. Na maka yeinom makyerɛ mo, na sɛ ɛberɛ no duru a, moakae sɛ maka makyerɛ mo.

Na manka mo yeinom mamfiri mfitiaseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ me ne mo na na ɛwɔ hɔ. Na afei deɛ, merekɔ deɛ ɔsomaa me no nkyɛn, na mo mu biara mmisa me sɛ: Ɛhe na worekorɔ? Na sɛ maka yeinom makyerɛ mo nti, awerɛhoɔ ahyɛ mo akoma ma.
Na meka mo nokorɛ; ɛyɛ ma mo sɛ mekorɔ. Na sɛ mankɔ a, Okyigyinafoɔ no remma mo nkyɛn, na sɛ mekɔ a, mɛsoma no aba mo nkyɛn. Na ɔno deɛ, sɛ ɔba a, ɔbɛyi wiase atɛn bɔne ne tenenee ne atemmuo ho. Bɔne ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnye me nni; ne tenenee ho, ɛfiri sɛ merekɔ Agya no nkyɛn, na monhu me bio; ne atemmuo ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔabu wiase sodifoɔ no atɛn.
Mewɔ nsɛm pii meka mekyerɛ mo, nanso montumi nsoa seesei. Na sɛ ɔno, nokorɛ Honhom no, nya ba a, ɔbɛkyerɛ mo kwan akɔ nokorɛ no nyinaa mu. Na ɛmfiri ɔno ara ne mu na ɔbɛkasa, na biribiara a ɔbɛteɛ no, ɔbɛka, na ɔbɛkyerɛ mo nnoɔma a ɛreba. Ɔno na ɔbɛhyɛ me animuonyam; ɛfiri sɛ, ɔbɛfa me deɛ bi na ɔde abɛkyerɛ mo. Nnoɔma a m’Agya wɔ nyinaa yɛ me dea; yei nti na mekaa sɛ: Ɔbɛfa me deɛ bi na ɔde abɛkyerɛ mo.

Aka kakraa bi na monhu me; na bio aka kakraa bi mobɛhu me. Ɛnna n’asuafoɔ no mu binom kekaa no wɔn mu sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ɔse yɛn yi sɛ: Aka kakraa bi na monhu me, na bio aka kakraa bi mobɛhu me, ne sɛ: Merekɔ Agya no nkyɛn yi? Ɛnna asuafoɔ no se: Ɛdeɛn ne deɛ ɔka yi sɛ: Aka kakraa bi? Yɛnte deɛ ɔreka yi ase. Ɛnna Yesu hunuu sɛ wɔrepɛ abisa no, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Yei ho na mobisabisa wɔ mo mu sɛ mekaa sɛ: Aka kakraa bi na monhu me, na bio aka kakraa bi mobɛhu me. Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Mobɛsu na moatwa adwo, na wiasefoɔ ani bɛgye; na mo deɛ, mo werɛ bɛho, nanso mo awerɛhoɔ no bɛdane anigyeɛ. Ɔbaa, sɛ ɔrewo a, ɔte yea, ɛfiri sɛ ne dɔn adu; na sɛ ɔnya wo ɔba no a, ɔnkae ahohia no bio, anigyeɛ a wanya sɛ wɔawo ɔba aba wiase no nti. Na mo nso, seesei deɛ, mowɔ awerɛhoɔ; na mɛhu mo bio, na mo akoma bɛtɔ mo yam, na mo anigyeɛ no, obi rennye mo nsam; na da no moremmisa me biribiara. Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Biribiara a mobɛsrɛ Agya no me din mu no, ɔde bɛma mo. Ɛde bɛduru sɛsɛɛ deɛ, monsrɛɛ biribi me din mu; monsrɛ, na mobɛnya, na mo anigyeɛ awie pɛyɛ.

Yeinom na maka mo mmebuo mu; na berɛ no reba a merenkasa menkyerɛ mo mmebuo mu bio, na mɛka Agya no ho asɛm makyerɛ mo pefee. Da no na mobɛsrɛ wɔ me din mu, na menka menkyerɛ mo sɛ mɛbisa Agya no mama mo, na Agya no ara dɔ mo, ɛfiri sɛ modɔ me, na moagye adi sɛ mefiri Agya no nkyɛn na mebaeɛ. Mefiri Agya no nkyɛn na mebaa wiase; na bio, merefiri wiase na makɔ Agya no nkyɛn.
N’asuafoɔ no see no sɛ: Hwɛ, afei deɛ, wokasa pefee, na wommu bɛ biara. Afei yɛahunu sɛ wonim nnoɔma nyinaa, na ɛnhia wo sɛ obi bisa woɔ; yei mu na yɛgye di sɛ wofiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn na ɛbaeɛ. Yesu bisaa wɔn sɛ: Afei deɛ, mogye di anaa? Hwɛ, dɔn no reba, na anya adu sɛ mo nyinaa bɛhwete akɔ mo nkuro mu, na moagya me nko; nanso ɛnkaa me nko, ɛfiri sɛ Agya no ka me ho. Yeinom na maka mo, na moanya me mu asomdwoeɛ. Mo ho bɛhiahia mo wiase deɛ, nanso momma mo bo ntɔ mo yam! Madi wiase so nkonim.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
